title: Lifting a configuration to a larger alphabet
statement: Let $e$ be an injection from the Boolean alphabet into an alphabet $\Gamma$, and let $c$ be a configuration with Boolean input $x$, state set $S$, and $k$ work tapes. The resulting configuration over input $e(x)$ has the same state, input-head position, and work-head positions; each nonblank work-tape symbol and each output symbol is mapped through $e$, with blanks preserved.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration with Boolean input $x$, state set $S$, and $k$ work tapes
